question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must create a Bash script to run in the Cisco NX-OS Guest Shell. The script must loop through the available namespaces and output all registered interfaces. Which code snippet completes the script?
for ns in /var/run/netns/*; do
  ______
  ifconfig
done
theory: Each VRF on the switch maps to its own Linux network namespace under /var/run/netns; Guest Shell's chvrf convenience utility switches the shell's current namespace context to a given namespace before running a command, so 'chvrf "$ns";' immediately followed by ifconfig makes ifconfig report the interfaces belonging specifically to that VRF/namespace on each loop iteration. echo and vrfinfo don't change execution context, and passing a namespace name directly as an ifconfig argument isn't valid syntax. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
